countyBallotCoverage.summary: Of our 14 congressional and legislative contests, 10 appear on Alameda ballots (CD 10, 12, 14, 17, SD 10, AD 14, 16, 18, 20, 24) and 4 on SF ballots (CD 11, 15, AD 17, 19). None is on both. BOE 2 is the only BOE district on either county ballot.

filedVsQualified.finding: sf.gov uses "have filed for candidacy" for Assessor-Recorder, Public Defender and Board of Education, and "have qualified" for all other SF contests including Supervisors, Community College Board, CCB partial term, BART 8, CD 11/15 and AD 17/19. The official VIP lists all three "filed" contests on the ballot (page 5) and prints statements for all their candidates, which indicates they are on the ballot. That is an inference, so the published wording should follow the source wording or say on the ballot per the VIP.
